change: Bind a batch COUNT update only for ungrouped non-DISTINCT COUNT. Preserve shared FILTER/argument evaluation, group ID construction, SUM and every other update path. Logical NULLs and checked overflow including successful-prefix state are preserved.
artifact_control: Baseline is the preserved freshly rebuilt main binary with verified SHA256; candidate explicitly cleans/rebuilds Roc and harness, preserving its executable. Harness and lockfiles are identical. Every process checks compiled source, executable, versions and lock hashes. No builds overlap timing.

design.order: Variant order randomized per paired process replica with seed 202610071; DF/Roc execution order alternates each timed sample; workload/thread order is fixed as in the unchanged harness.
design.scope: Full warm-cache Snappy Parquet SQL execution and output collection, planning/conversion excluded. Fresh timing samples for both binaries; earlier main samples are not reused.

statistics: Geometric mean of five process medians for each variant/case/engine. Reduction=(1-count/main)*100. Paired process log-ratio bootstrap with 10000 five-cluster resamples; intervals describe observed variation, not all system/binary-layout confounders. All native DataFusion control movements are recorded.
